digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767), which matches the Jira Data Center default for jira.text.field.character.limit but silently truncates comments when an admin has raised or removed the limit, causing silent data loss

the configurability gap affects only non-stock instances where jira.text.field.character.limit differs from 32767, making it a latent defect for any operator who raised the limit to accept longer comments

sanitize_comment reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound), creating structural coupling that could break comments if description fitting changes, as evidenced by Cloud's ADF-size-based description limit being incompatible with plain character truncation
the endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings is admin-only and unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, eliminating runtime discovery of the limit as a viable remediation
comment_max_chars must be made a configurable parameter with default 32767, proven by red-first unit tests that fail under raised ceilings and pass under the stock default
